description: Schedule existing FLUF products to go live on one or more marketplaces at a chosen date and time, instead of listing them now. Optional per-channel times, spacing between items and a drop name. Confirm items, channels and time with the seller before sending confirmed: true. Accepted is not live: the items are listed when the time comes and then appear in the listings log; the seller can see, move or cancel them on the calendar at calendar_url. Channels completed by the seller's own extension or app need it open around that time. Requires a write-enabled API token.

channel_times.description: Per-channel override of scheduled_at, keyed by target: {"vinted": "2026-10-14T20:00"}.

confirmed.description: True only after the seller approves the items, channels and time.

drop_name.description: Name for this batch, shown as one group on the seller's calendar.

scheduled_at.description: When the listings go live, in the seller's local time: 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM'. A past time means as soon as possible.

stagger_minutes.description: Minutes between items, so a batch goes out one at a time instead of all at once. 0 = all at once.

targets.description: Channels to list on, from list_channels. Append a connection id to pick one of several stores: 'depop:208'.

tz.description: IANA timezone for scheduled_at, e.g. 'Europe/London'. Defaults to UTC.

vids.description: Product handles to list, taken verbatim from the `vid` field of list_products (e.g. 'shopify_123456_0').

name: schedule_crosslist
